separation: Separate arm and disjoint seeds from EXP-021 v2 four-arm experiment. Criteria are frozen before any H2-prime game.
public_gate_two_selection: Existing frozen public-guard rank, first two after excluding O and DP.

mutation.priority_a: If actual step-0 action contains SELL WHEAT with positive quantity, decrement the first such order by one.
mutation.priority_b: Otherwise decrement the last BUY_PRODUCT WHEAT with positive quantity by one.
mutation.quote: q0 is the step-0 WHEAT market quote.
mutation.expected_difference: rival money minus our money: +q0 for one fewer SELL, -q0 for one fewer BUY_PRODUCT.
mutation.mirror: At step 1, after parent processing, abs((rival money - our money) - expected_difference) <= 2; if true set _RACE_STATE[player].level=24.

telemetry_gate.o: Both seats, 2 games. Each requires absolute cash difference >=1, our_mirror=1, opponent _RACE_REPORT.race_mirror=0.
telemetry_gate.nonmirror: DP and the two frozen public files, both seats, 6 games. Each requires our_mirror=0.
telemetry_gate.reuse: The two O gate games use the first screen seed and are included in the 100-game screen; they are not discarded or rerun.
telemetry_gate.failure: Any failure => STOP H2-prime without modification. The four-arm v2 experiment continues independently.

invalid: Our arm exception, caught_errors, timeout, steps !=720, or either status !=DONE. Opponent-side caught_errors are recorded but do not invalidate.
statistics: Both seats. Parent comparisons use empirical paired seed-level differences. Paired 95% lower endpoint uses t_(0.975,n-1). Primary O uses Wilson 99% lower bound with z=2.576 and effective successes wins+0.5*draws.

guard.pass: zero files where arm score rate is more than 0.10 below parent

confirmation.runtime: all H2-prime games: exception 0, max step <0.5s, empirical p99 <0.10s
confirmation.activation: against nonclone DP and public guard opponents, our mirror activation rate <=2%
